notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.6
notes.notes:
Upgrade the engine to UE5.6.

 This upgrade comes with some performance improvements.
 Shader compilation/loading on game start up may take slightly longer.

 The journal has been added, which can be accessed with "J" or bound to another key. This provides hints to puzzles over time if you get stuck.
 Slightly increase the dot crosshair to improve visibility on lower resolutions.
 The frame limit will no longer apply when you have frame generation enabled.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.5
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Ensure only digits can be entered into the room code field
 Limit the maximum length of the room code field
 The room code will now be copied to your clipboard when interacted with either from the lobby board or in the menu
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch notes v0.4.4
notes.notes:
Fix bug where rebinding a key to space would cause the player to walk forward when using space
 Fix typo on the board in the lobby

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.3
notes.notes:
Added an achievement for completing the house map in hard mode.
 Added an achievement for completing the office map.
 Added an achievement for completing the office map in hard mode.
 Added zoom functionality. This can be toggled using the Z-key or the keybind can be changed under "Controls" in the settings menu.
 Added a stamina indicator around the crosshair.
 Fixed bug where the flashlight was visible in the end game cutscene.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.2
notes.notes:
Updated crosshair to have an outline so it is easier to see under the flashlight.
 Updated all cabinets and drawers to open and shut on single click for ease of use. All regular doors still function as before.
 Patched bug with keycard puzzle in office map that preventing other keycard rooms from being unlocked when the keycard puzzle was completed.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.1
notes.notes:
Add additional subtitles to puzzles to provide clarity
 Increase some sounds from puzzles so they can be heard more clearly and from further away
 Updated hitbox for the computer so it is more obvious that it can be used

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
The office level has been released with 10 new puzzles and 2 new ghosts. This is unlocked after you have completed the first map.
 The lobby has been updated so you can now walk around.
 You will now return to the lobby after completing a map instead of being sent back to the main menu.
 Various issues relating to voice chat have been resolved.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.9
notes.notes:
With this patch there have been various performance optimisations, including:

 Added a "Hair Quality" option to the settings under "Graphics". Setting this to "Low" will have better performance.
 Improve the performance of both Player and Ghost models.
 Replaced surrounding trees with more optimised models. A fog has also been added to the distance with some of the background trees removed for performance reasons.
 Improved performance when inspecting notes & items.
 Fixed an issue with basement stairs area that was causing significant lag.
 Various updates to the optimal graphics settings calculator that determines the best settings for your hardware.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.8
notes.notes:
Fix issue where sometimes night would be over exposed on "Low" global illumination setting.
 Update reflection settings to prevent a visual bug.
 Show warning on frame generation setting due to known issue with stuttering while enabled, which can be resolved by turning frame generation off and then on again. Frame generation is now off by default.
 Hide settings that aren't available for certain hardware.
 Improve performance with flashlight.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.7
notes.notes:
The house interior is no longer bright when shadows are set to "Low" in the settings.
 The house interior is darker when global illumination is set to "Low" to be closer aligned to the visual experience of "High" global illumination.
 A button has been added to the graphics settings which will reset your settings to the optimal settings for your hardware.
 Gamma can now be adjusted in the settings under "Display".
 An issue where the mouse input would sometimes not register on small movements has been patched.
 A warning has been added to the main menu if your system is low on memory. This won't stop you from playing the game, but will suggest you close some applications to improve performance.

notes.title: Patch notes v0.3.6
notes.notes:
Fix bug where ghost could not enter door when player dies while holding door
 Fix bug where ghost was getting stuck in one spot
 Fix bug where room ambience audio was sometimes not being played
 Slightly decrease max ghost speed and spawn rate on hard mode

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.5
notes.notes:
The crucifix will now be used if the ghost overlaps the player while the player is holding the crucifix, even if the player is not looking directly at the ghost
- The crucifix will still be used from a distance if pointed at the ghost
 Medium difficulty has been rebalanced so the ghost is easier to handle later in the game
- The maximum speed has been reduced
- The maximum spawn rate has been reduced
- The spawn near player chance has been reduced
 Added messaging on certain items when first used to help explain their purpose

notes.title: Patch notes v0.3.4
notes.notes:
Add support to play with a controller in game (you currently still need a mouse/keyboard to navigate the menu/UI)
 Add more key rebinding options in the settings under the "Controls" tab
 Added an end game screen when all players die to provide more context
 Fix issue where some control settings were not applied to the player after dying
 Fix drawers in bedroom from blocking the bathroom door when open

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.3
notes.notes:
The breaker now only needs to be solved once per game. If the breaker turns off then any further interactions with the breaker will immediately turn the breaker back on.
 Sprint and Crouch can now be set to a toggle in the settings menu under the "Controls" tab

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.2
notes.notes: Various performance improvements

notes.title: Patch notes v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where the sky would not render correctly
 Fixed bug that sometimes caused stuttering when frame generation was enabled

notes.title: Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
Completion times for each map are now saved and can be viewed from the main menu
 Times are tracked separately based on game mode, difficulty, and the number of players
 Times are recorded in two scenarios:

 If all the puzzles in the map are completed (requires checking 'Reset Puzzles' in the lobby if you have previously completed any puzzles)
 If all memories are scattered at the start of the map (requires previously completing all the puzzles, and not checking 'Reset Puzzles' in the lobby)

notes.title: Patch notes v0.2.1
notes.notes:
You can now adjust mouse smoothing in the settings
 Fix light bleed from slide projector puzzle

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
Difficulty Modes

 You can now select from four difficulty modes when in the lobby: Puzzles Only, Easy, Medium & Hard.
 Medium will be similar to the existing difficulty.
 When playing Puzzles Only, you can no longer die, though the ghost will still roam.
 Difficulty affects ghost behaviour (spawn rate, speed) and how much Sanity impacts ghost spawn rate


Other updates

 You can now invert the X & Y axis in the settings
 You can now change your mouse sensitivity in the settings
 Refined some scenery collisions

notes.title: Patch notes v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Solved issues with crucifix activation. The crucifix should now always stun the ghost and save you, provided you're looking at it.
 Made the ghost remain stunned for longer when a crucifix activates on it
 Shadows and global illumination settings will default to lower settings, as these were contributing to significant slowdowns on older machines


if you experience poor performance, this can be due to shader compilation, which only happens once. Walking around the map and waiting for this can alleviate it - we're currently looking into better solutions for this.
